g.text: Example of how platform teams host their own services and applications in normal
landing zone subscriptions. This can be in one or many subscriptions, depending
on the subscription vending model that has been adopted.
Virtual machine image management and platform team APIs for subscription
vending, Microsoft Entra ID tasks, and others.
Cloud Adoption Framework · pencil-sketch redraw of the Microsoft Azure landing zone reference architecture (hub & spoke) and management group hierarchy
